copilot.title: AI Farm Copilot
copilot.subtitle: Your multilingual Gemini-powered assistant. Ask questions about irrigation, soil compaction, and disease management.
copilot.groundingDesc: This context is automatically injected into Gemini's prompt to keep responses grounded in your farm's live telemetry.
copilot.defaultInferred: The cotton plants are experiencing moderate water stress during the crucial flowering period, which is causing vegetative density to decrease.
copilot.defaultRec1: Run a 12mm irrigation cycle in West Field.
copilot.defaultRec2: Consider Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) to strengthen root resilience.
copilot.defaultRec3: Spray organic shield (Pseudomonas fluorescens) if humidity increases.

hero.lead: TerraPulse AI combines satellite monitoring, AI-assisted plant and soil analysis, and carbon-credit simulation to help farms stay healthy, resilient, and regenerative.

capabilities.title: One platform, three intelligence layers
capabilities.sub: From orbit-level monitoring to leaf-level diagnosis and carbon-aware planning.
capabilities.healthDesc: Satellite-powered field monitoring with NDVI, moisture stress, vegetation analytics, and interactive field maps.
capabilities.scannerDesc: Upload a leaf or soil photo for AI-assisted disease and degradation analysis with regenerative recommendations.
capabilities.carbonDesc: Plan a 3-year crop rotation and simulate soil organic carbon recovery, yield resilience, and voluntary carbon credits.

how.title: A clear path from monitoring to restoration
how.step1Desc: Satellite imagery tracks field NDVI, moisture, and vegetation health continuously.
how.step2Desc: AI scans plant and soil images to detect disease, stress, and degradation early.
how.step3Desc: Cover-crop and bio-fertilizer recommendations improve soil and yields sustainably.
how.step4Desc: Simulate carbon recovery and carbon-credit potential from regenerative rotations.
